title: Bengals’ Andrei Iosivas reveals disgusting online trolls got ‘in my head’ last season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bengals’ Andrei Iosivas reveals disgusting online trolls got ‘in my head’ last season
sources.description: The Bengals wide receiver said the situation last season “makes me angry” as he recalled the messages he got from fans during a campaign in which he had a team-high five drops.
